svg.title: Ragged regions — 039 / After the weights reveal — 27 June responders
svg.desc: Fog of war, Ragged regions: 039 / After the weights reveal, 27 June responders. Schematic drawn claim terrain; P1 hatched; P2 dark; P3 dark; P4 dark; P5 dark. P1 outer foothold hatched. Observation islands: response lit, correction dark, configuration dark, weights dark. P6 remains dark and unreachable. Dark means no available support, not false. Contours remain fixed across fixtures. Design sample, not adopted. Fog has a soft irregular edge; unexplored ground is opaque, ground that lost support stays dimly visible.
svg.text: OUR INFERENCE / SCHEMATIC TERRAIN / FOG IS COMPUTED, NOT MEASURED
A READER REVELATION IS NOT A NEW REPORT TO THE JUNE RESPONDERS.
